name: @pipeworx/mcp-bcb-br

tools.name: sgs_series
tools.description: Fetch any Banco Central do Brasil SGS time series by numeric code. Common codes: 432=Selic target, 11=Selic daily, 433=IPCA inflation, 1=USD/BRL PTAX sell, 21619=USD/BRL, 4389=CDI. Returns {series_code, series_name, country:"Brazil", statement, count, observations:[{data:"dd/MM/yyyy", valor:"..."}]}. Use "last" for the most recent N observations, or a date range.

last.description: Return only the most recent N observations, e.g. 12. Omit for full/ranged series.

tools.name: indicator
tools.description: Convenience lookup for common Brazilian macro indicators by friendly name (no SGS code needed). names: selic_target, selic_daily, ipca, usd_brl_ptax, usd_brl, cdi. Returns the latest N observations with the series label and unit.

name.description: One of: selic_target, selic_daily, ipca, usd_brl_ptax, usd_brl, cdi.

last.description: How many recent observations to return (default 12, max 1000).

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List the friendly indicator names available to the "indicator" tool, with their SGS codes and units.

tools.name: ptax_usd
tools.description: Official PTAX USD/BRL quote for a specific business day (buy + sell rate, timestamp). Returns {cotacaoCompra, cotacaoVenda, dataHoraCotacao}. Quotes are not published on weekends/holidays.

date.description: Quote date in MM-dd-yyyy (US order), e.g. "05-27-2026". Must be a business day.

tools.name: focus_expectations
tools.description: Focus market expectations survey — annual median/mean forecasts from ~150 economists. Filter by indicator (e.g. "IPCA", "Selic", "PIB Total", "Câmbio", "IGP-M") and optionally reference year. Returns latest survey rows with Media, Mediana, Minimo, Maximo, numeroRespondentes.

indicator.description: Indicador name in Portuguese, e.g. "IPCA", "Selic", "PIB Total", "Câmbio".

reference_year.description: DataReferencia year to filter, e.g. "2026". Optional.

top.description: Max rows to return (default 10, max 100). Ordered by survey Data descending.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bcb-br forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bcb-br pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
